reason: I always forget pills at home and I travel twice a month, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my bag fits me. The named lab and the report for my batch make me trust it more than the usual TikTok Shop stuff, and $24.99 for the first box is an easy try.
objection: It is still 2 capsules every day, and I do not know if I will stick with it past the first box. Also $29.99 a month is a bit much for magnesium when I can get a big bottle at the store for less.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that the lab report for the batch really opens and matches the box number, or a lower regular price around $25.
